common: Create ONE isolated full-body game entity sprite on genuine transparent background. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match its handmade muted natural palette, crisp dark contour, dense yet readable pixel clusters, upper-left lighting and top-down three-quarter RPG view. Production pixel art, designed at roughly 64-96 pixels tall then enlarged with nearest neighbor. Flat solid colors only: exactly shadow/base/highlight for each material plus one dark outline. No gradients, no antialias, no blur, no dithering/noise, no floor or cast shadow, no text, no UI. Detailed purposeful facets and interlocking shapes like the reference leaves, not smooth illustration. Single front three-quarter idle standing pose, whole body visible, centered with transparent padding.
specs: A squat heavy swamp golem built of mossy stones and twisted roots, drooping moss shoulder pads, small muted amber eyes, two powerful fists and short grounded legs. Small ordinary enemy, not a boss.

A squat desert sandstone golem, eroded angular ochre stone slabs, dark fissures, tiny pale electric blue crystal eyes and a small blue crystal set in chest, broad fists, short grounded legs. Small ordinary enemy, not a boss.

The Ember Lord boss: towering ancient charred tree and basalt guardian, asymmetrical massive root arms, jagged burnt crown, dark bark plates with restrained glowing amber cracks and ember heart. Heavy rooted feet, regal threatening silhouette, no weapon.

The Frost Lord boss: powerful ancient stone guardian armored with angular pale blue ice, towering jagged crystal crown and wide icy shoulders, one enormous grasping claw hand and one heavy fist, articulated feet, muted turquoise heart. Regal threatening silhouette.

The Gale Lord boss: lean ancient weathered sage-grey stone guardian with swept back horn crown, wind-carved layered armor, long powerful grasping arms, pale mint cloth-like carved ribbons attached to body, articulated heavy feet. Dynamic asymmetrical silhouette, muted teal heart, no detached effects.

The Rot Lord boss: broad hulking ancient swamp guardian made of tangled dark roots and mossy stone, hunched canopy-like shoulders with a few dull ochre shelf mushrooms, enormous root claw hands, hollow amber eyes, restrained muted olive poison heart, thick rooted feet. Monstrous majestic readable silhouette.

The Thunder Lord boss: majestic ancient desert stone guardian, warm weathered sandstone and dark bronze armor, forked lightning-shaped crown, huge sweeping forearms with inset pale cyan crystals, articulated heavy feet, bright but flat colored electric blue heart. Regal threatening silhouette, no floating bolts.
